newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-P&O sells Australian towage operations.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-P&O sells Australian towage operations.

text.p: Marine service firms The Adelaide Steamship Co Ltd and Howard Smith Ltd said on Thursday they had jointly acquired P & O Australia's towage activities.
The acquisition of four tugboats and three line boats marks the exit of P & O from the marine towage business in Australia.
All the boats operate out of Western Australia, with two tugs at Geraldton, two at Kwinana and the three line boats in Fremantle outer-harbour.
Adsteam and Howard Smith said they had an existing interest in the Kwinana tugs through its Medina Maritime Services joint venture with P & O and would purchase P & O's Medina shareholding.
By 3.20 p.m. (0420 GMT), Howard Smith shares were five cents higher at A$10.40 on turnover of 49,411 shares while Adsteam shares were steady at four cents on turnover of 9,283 shares.
